metadata.title: Exploring the relationship between process data and contextual variables among Scandinavian students on PISA 2012 mathematics tasks

design_fields.q1_rationale: Plausible values are not applicable because the dependent variables are item-level response accuracy and other process data indicators, not PV-based achievement scores.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study explicitly states that it used student weights in the analysis, acknowledging the two-stage sampling design of PISA.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not mention using multilevel modeling or any methods that account for school clustering, indicating that it likely used student-level models.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study does not mention any external validation strategies and appears to rely solely on internal validation methods.
